title: Address check
description: A project-address field moves from checking to an inline validation result.
useCase: Resolve an address choice while preserving the user’s typing flow.
interaction: Edit the address, then blur or select Check address.
reducedMotion: State icons and borders change immediately; validation remains functional.
limitations: Uses a local list of reserved names and a syntax rule; it does not check a real domain or service.
look: Near-white page with a small dark-green square icon, a white rounded text field with a grey suffix, grey helper text and a full-width near-black button.
motion: After blur or submit, edits show a checking state that a 450 ms debounce resolves to available, taken or invalid; errors shift the field border to red over 150 ms.
adapt: Validation is the `useEffect` on `value` and `touched`: a 450 ms `setTimeout`, cleared on every edit, sets `status`, which CSS reads through `data-invalid` and `data-state`. Replace the regex and reserved-name list with your availability request, and abort stale requests.
